verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an official CLI (gt) with npm/Homebrew install and documented config, plus a documented MCP server (gt-mcp), giving AI-native users official tooling to build against. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose SDK (e.g., Python/JS client library) or public API/OpenAPI spec — probes for openapi.json all 404'd. missing for 10: official SDK/client libraries beyond the CLI, public API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent developer corroboration of building against these interfaces.
